    def __init__(

        ready: asyncio.Future[Any],

        return self._done

    def events(self) -> AsyncIterator[dict[str, Any]]:

        return self._events

I implemented the streaming layer for the LangGraph Python SDK's event protocol under `libs/sdk-py/langgraph_sdk/stream/`:

**`multi_cursor_buffer.py`** — `MultiCursorBuffer[T]`
- `__aiter__` is an async generator, so each `async for` gets a fresh cursor starting at index 0 and replays the full buffered sequence, then suspends on a per-iterator future.

**`subscription.py`** — pure matching helpers
- `normalize_segment` strips at first colon; `is_prefix_match` normalizes namespace segments but treats colon-containing prefix segments as exact literals; `namespace_matches` short-circuits on empty/None prefixes and enforces the depth cap; `infer_channel` maps methods (including `custom`/`custom:{name}`); `matches_subscription` checks channel membership (bare `custom` matches any `custom:*`) plus optional namespace filtering.
